550:t_1:4.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...Thanks for minding the place, $$カリーニン$$.」

550:t_1:7.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「No... it's nothing. I'm just glad you're safe.」

550:t_1:9.en:
$$カリーニン$$
(She's only seventeen, yet she carries herself like a king who rules the world... Is she truly that $$千鳥かなめ$$...?)

550:t_1:10.en:
$$レナード$$
「You seem to have felt her transformation.」

550:t_1:12.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$クルツ・ウェーバー$$, who used to be your subordinate, is dead.」

550:t_1:13.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「...We lost $$カスパー$$ as well, but the loss of $$ウェーバー$$ must hurt them badly too. Depending on how things go, he was a more troublesome presence than $$相良$$.」

550:t_1:14.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You don't need to worry anymore, $$カリーニン$$. I killed $$宗介$$ and $$テッサ$$.」

550:t_1:16.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's all right, Mr. K.」

550:t_1:17.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It starts from here, doesn't it, $$レナード$$.」

550:t_1:18.en:
$$レナード$$
「Yes... The temple, built for your sake... and to save us all, is already complete.」

550:t_1:19.en:
$$レナード$$
「The enemies who have grasped that intent will come too... If we meet them here on $$メリダ島$$, it will all be over.」

550:t_1:20.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$メリダ島$$... I never thought I'd end up coming here like th...is... huh...」

550:t_1:24.en:
$$レナード$$
(So some of $$千鳥かなめ$$'s feelings still remain...)

550:t_1:25.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Let's go, $$レナード$$. I want to see the biggest, greatest $$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$ right away.」

550:t_1:26.en:
$$レナード$$
「Understood. ...Mr. K, I leave the rest to you.」

550:t_1:28.en:
$$カリーニン$$
(I had heard about what happened at $$ヤムスク１１$$ in the reports, but seeing it with my own eyes, I can't help being shaken...)

550:t_1:29.en:
$$カリーニン$$
(Is that pure, upright girl truly lost forever...?)

550:t_1:30.en:
$$カリーニン$$
(But perhaps that was her fate...)

550:t_1:31.en:
$$カリーニン$$
(...What is there to hesitate over now...? I chose to believe $$レナード$$'s words that he would set this world right.)

550:t_1:32.en:
$$カリーニン$$
(That unease I have felt all along... This world is a warped world...)

550:t_1:33.en:
$$カリーニン$$
($$イリーナ$$... A world that lost you is a mistaken history...)

550:t_1:34.en:
$$カリーニン$$
(If it's to redo everything, I no longer have any hesitation or doubt...)

550:t_1:38.en: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Captain's Cabin ～

550:t_1:39.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Report on the status of each unit.」

550:t_1:40.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「A report has arrived from Staff Officer $$城田$$ on the detached force that headed to Japan.」

550:t_1:41.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「According to it, they have determined that the mysterious robot army was the work of the $$ガイゾック$$ that were in the $$ＵＣＷ$$...」

550:t_1:42.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Furthermore, they have confirmed the revival of $$皇帝ズール$$, the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, and $$ハーデス$$ of $$ミケーネ$$.」

550:t_1:43.en:
$$テッサ$$
(That timing... As I thought, events are starting to move rapidly...)

550:t_1:44.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「In addition, the $$トライダー$$, $$ダイ・ガード$$, $$ダイターン３$$, $$ゴッドマーズ$$, $$鉄人２８号#robot$$, $$マジンガーＺ$$, $$真ゲッターロボ$$, and $$ダンクーガノヴァマックスゴッド$$ have...」

550:t_1:45.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「...each achieved a power-up, and the $$くろがね五人衆$$ and Prince $$グーラ$$ have offered to cooperate, I'm told.」

550:t_1:46.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「There are also reports that the $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$ and $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$, and the $$真ゲッター１$$ and $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$, three invincible robots, can now use combination attacks.」

550:t_1:47.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「However, due to the fighting in other dimensions and so on, each unit is badly damaged and, as things stand, unable to carry out operations.」

550:t_1:48.en:
$$テッサ$$
「What about the units operating in space?」

550:t_1:49.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「They have reportedly secured the cooperation of $$ハマーン・カーン$$'s group, who defected from $$ネオ・ジオン$$, and $$ギュネイ・ガス$$.」

550:t_1:50.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Furthermore, having succeeded in severing $$ザフト$$ from $$ネオ・ジオン$$, they have effectively halved their forces.」

550:t_1:51.en:
$$テッサ$$
「That will keep $$ネオ・ジオン$$ from intervening in the fight against the Empire.」

550:t_1:52.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「It has also been confirmed that Ensign $$リディ$$ survived, but I'm told he rides a black $$ユニコーンガンダム$$ called the $$バンシィ$$ and has become leader of the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives' strike unit.」

550:t_1:53.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Those $$クロノ$$ used Vice Foreign Minister $$リリーナ・ドーリアン$$ as a hostage to demand their surrender, but they reportedly succeeded in protecting the Vice Minister.」

550:t_1:54.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「There are also reports that in the course of the fighting, the Gundams have been strengthened or have become able to use new functions.」

550:t_1:56.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Unfortunately, they are stationed on the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$. With repairs to each unit and so on as well, they cannot come to Earth right away.」

550:t_1:57.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Report our situation here to each detached force. Since they won't make it in time, we will go to $$メリダ島$$ on our own.」

550:t_1:59.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Don't worry, $$マデューカス$$. Considering the battlefield, we should need breakthrough power more than large-scale forces.」

550:t_1:60.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We will hold a briefing in six hours. Please gather all personnel in the hangar of the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$.」

550:t_1:62.en:
$$テッサ$$
($$レナード$$... I can't hand this world over to your ego...)

550:t_1:63.en:
$$テッサ$$
(We will stake our lives on that.)
